title: last night I dreamt of a museum that had stacks of taxidermy crabs everywhere. At the end of the museum there was a hall with toilets & birthday cakes
content: Is this mallworld? The place was so packed we all had to keep moving for crowd control, we couldn’t stop to look at things. I found an ant that had escaped & helped the staff member catch it. They thanked me and then just cast the ant away again rather than putting it in an enclosure.
